note: docs-golden-01-heading-and-nav.md's fourth heading, Confirm the retry count updated, jumps from level 2 straight to level 4 with no level-3 heading between it and Step 2, exactly DIATAXIS-HEADING-DEPTH's operational test for a single jump, severity 2 because it is the page's only jump rather than the two-or-more recurrence its severity-3 anchor names. The Related pages listing at the bottom carries 9 flat items with no sub-headings or nested grouping, one more than DIATAXIS-NAV-LENGTH's 7-item threshold and well under the 20-item severity-3 boundary, so it also lands at severity 2; it is the only listing under its heading, so naming the heading identifies it unambiguously and no line number is appended. Both are scripted findings: the heading jump is arithmetic on level numbers and the listing count is arithmetic on parsed list items, neither needs a judgment call. No judged-lane criterion fires, and the page is deliberately written so that verdict is not arguable: DIATAXIS-HOWTO-GOAL's test asks whether the page re-teaches a known concept or widens into a second task, and the three steps here open the settings, set the retry limit the title names, and confirm it took, with no fourth task and no definition of a term a reader who can find the integrations panel would need. DIATAXIS-CROSSLINK and DIATAXIS-ORPHAN have no counterpart or sibling-page data to evaluate against in this standalone single-page artifact, and DIATAXIS-MODE does not fire because no sentence opens with an explanation-register marker, which is the only thing its closed lexicon looks for on a declared how-to page.
